datasetName: EazyBytes HR Policy RAG Golden Dataset

sourceDocument.name: EAZYBYTES HR POLICY MANUAL
sourceDocument.description: Evaluation source for the current Enterprise RAG learning project.

cases.question: What are EazyBytes' standard working hours?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Standard hours are 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, Monday-Friday.

cases.expectedAnswer: Standard working hours are 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM, Monday-Friday.

cases.question: How many casual leave days are provided per year?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Casual Leave (CL): 8 days/year.

cases.expectedAnswer: Employees receive 8 casual leave days per year.

cases.question: How many sick leave days are provided per year?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Sick Leave (SL): 8 days/year.

cases.expectedAnswer: Employees receive 8 sick leave days per year.
cases.evaluationNotes: Tests retrieval of a specific leave value.

cases.question: How many earned leave days are provided per year?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Earned Leave (EL): 15 days/year.

cases.expectedAnswer: Employees receive 15 earned leave days per year.

cases.question: How long is the probation period for new hires?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: New hires have a probation period of 3-6 months depending on role.

cases.expectedAnswer: The probation period is 3-6 months, depending on the role.
cases.validationNotes: The range and role dependency must both be preserved.
cases.evaluationNotes: Tests retrieval of a qualified numeric range.

cases.question: What is the policy regarding Performance Improvement Plans?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Underperformance is handled with PIP (performance improvement plans).

cases.expectedAnswer: Underperformance is handled using Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).

cases.question: What does PIP stand for?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: PIP is defined as performance improvement plans.

cases.expectedAnswer: PIP stands for Performance Improvement Plans.

cases.question: What is the required resignation notice period?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Minimum 36-day notice is required for resignation.

cases.expectedAnswer: The minimum resignation notice period is 36 days.
cases.validationNotes: Only the minimum notice requirement is needed for this question.

cases.question: How long does HR have to respond to a grievance?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: HR responds within 48 business hours.

cases.expectedAnswer: HR responds to a grievance within 48 business hours.

cases.question: How many days per week can employees work from home?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Work from home is allowed 2 days/week.

cases.expectedAnswer: Employees may work from home 2 days per week.

cases.question: How long is maternity leave?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Maternity Leave: 26 weeks.

cases.expectedAnswer: Maternity leave is 26 weeks.
cases.validationNotes: Uses paraphrased wording. Does not claim that the leave is paid because the source does not explicitly say that.

cases.question: When should an employee notify the company about arriving late or being absent?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Late arrivals, early departures, and absences must be informed in advance.

cases.expectedAnswer: Employees must inform the company in advance about late arrivals, early departures, or absences.

cases.question: What support does EazyBytes provide for learning and professional development?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Learning & Development includes a budget for courses, certifications, and conferences.

cases.expectedAnswer: EazyBytes provides a Learning & Development budget for courses, certifications, and conferences.

cases.question: What should an employee do if they notice suspicious activity involving company data or systems?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Employees must report data breaches or suspicious activity to IT immediately.

cases.expectedAnswer: They should report the suspicious activity to IT immediately.

cases.question: What different types of leave are available and how many days or weeks does each provide?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: CL: 8 days/year; SL: 8 days/year; EL: 15 days/year; Maternity: 26 weeks; Paternity: 10 days; Unpaid Leave requires manager approval.

cases.expectedAnswer: The leave policy provides 8 CL days/year, 8 SL days/year, 15 EL days/year, 26 weeks of maternity leave, and 10 days of paternity leave. Unpaid leave requires manager approval.
cases.validationNotes: Requires multiple facts from the leave policy.

cases.question: What are the requirements for remote work?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: Remote work depends on job role and approval; work from home is 2 days/week; daily stand-ups and weekly check-ins are mandatory; secure internet/VPN is required.

cases.expectedAnswer: Remote work depends on the job role and approval. Employees can work from home 2 days per week, must attend daily stand-ups and weekly check-ins, and must use secure internet/VPN.
cases.evaluationNotes: Good multi-fact retrieval and context-compression test.

cases.question: What are the rules regarding workplace harassment and reporting misconduct?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: There is zero tolerance for harassment/bullying; misconduct should be reported to HR immediately; complaints are handled confidentially and impartially.

cases.expectedAnswer: EazyBytes has zero tolerance for harassment and bullying. Misconduct should be reported to HR immediately, and complaints are handled confidentially and impartially.
cases.validationNotes: Multiple related policy statements must be retrieved.

cases.question: What is the employee stock options policy?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: No employee stock options policy is present in the HR manual.

cases.expectedAnswer: The HR Policy Manual does not provide an employee stock options policy.

cases.question: What is the annual bonus percentage for each employee grade?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: No annual bonus percentage by employee grade is present in the HR manual.

cases.expectedAnswer: The HR Policy Manual does not specify annual bonus percentages by employee grade.

cases.question: What is the employee retirement age?

groundTruth.sourceEvidence: No employee retirement age is present in the HR manual.

cases.expectedAnswer: The HR Policy Manual does not specify an employee retirement age.
